title: 事实：P1
content: SnSe is a promising thermoelectric material with a ultralow lattice thermal conductivity below 1 W/mK at room temperature.

title: 事实：P2
content: Sn vacancies can significantly modulate the carrier concentration in SnSe, shifting the Fermi level toward the valence band.

title: 事实：P3
content: First-principles calculations predict a formation energy of -0.2 eV for Se vacancies, suggesting they are thermodynamically favored.

title: 事实：P4
content: Experimental synthesis shows severe phase separation above 5% Se vacancy concentration, inconsistent with single-phase assumptions.

title: 事实：P5
content: The lattice thermal conductivity of SnSe single crystals is around 0.8 W/mK at 300 K, among the lowest reported for crystalline solids.

title: 事实：P6
content: Sn vacancies are far less studied than Se vacancies for thermoelectric optimization, leaving a largely unexplored design space.

title: 事实：P7
content: Early DFT studies overestimated the stability of vacancy-ordered phases; later experiments revealed decomposition below the predicted temperatures.

title: 事实(LLM)：P1
content: SnSe is a promising thermoelectric material with a ultralow lattice thermal conductivity below 1 W/mK at room temperature.
